title: OpenClaw Skill Workshop Guide: Create Custom Skills with Governance
summary: OpenClaw Skill Workshop (v2026.6.1) replaces dropping SKILL.md files with a governed proposal → review → approve flow. Complete guide with CLI commands and examples.
body_markdown: ` rejected` is a final decision — you declined the proposal with a logged reason.` quarantined` is a hold — the proposal stays in queue for deeper review and counts toward your` maxPending` limit (default 50). Use` quarantined` when a proposal needs a security or compliance check before making a final call.
